name: live-subtitle-translator
description: Personal-use Chrome extension that overlays bilingual live subtitles on YouTube/Twitch videos (Phase 0: technical validation).

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lst/protocol && npm run build -w @lst/server && npm run build -w @lst/extension
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev -w @lst/server
